mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "user" ( login_id, password, name, role, team_name, daily_limit, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{teamName}, #{dailyLimit}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, password, name, role, team_name, daily_limit, use_yn, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM "user" WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, login_id, password, name, role, team_name, daily_limit, use_yn, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM "user" WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.update:

mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.daily_limit, u.use_yn, COUNT(ph.id) AS today_used_count, GREATEST(0, u.daily_limit - COUNT(ph.id)) AS remaining_count FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN prompt_history ph ON ph.user_id = u.id AND ph.init_regi_dttm >= CURRENT_DATE AND ph.init_regi_dttm < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY u.id, u.login_id, u.name, u.daily_limit, u.use_yn ORDER BY u.id ASC
